What's new

Every version of Burnfeed, newest first.

2.0 · October 2026

  • A fresh look: Burnfeed's popup and settings feel at home on your Mac, in light and dark.
  • Where a feed was, a quote now sits quietly in the site's own colors.
  • Burning and pausing take effect instantly, in every open tab, without reloading.
  • Show a feed for 5, 15 or 60 minutes, or pause everything; it burns again on its own.
  • Choose how a burned feed looks: gone, frosted, ashes, redacted or faded.
  • Pick exactly what goes on each site, from YouTube comments and suggested videos to X's trending panel, right from the toolbar button.
  • Burned feeds stop loading in the background, so pages are lighter and you can't scroll into an empty feed.
  • When a site changes its layout, fixes arrive on their own, no update needed. If Burnfeed can't find a feed, it tells you and lets you report it in one click.
  • Your settings and quotes from earlier versions come with you.

1.5 · May 2024

  • Fixed the feed coming back on all six sites.
  • Fixed Reddit.
  • You can turn the quotes off and keep an empty space where the feed was.

1.21 · December 2022

  • Turning a site off in Burnfeed no longer removes its Safari permission, so turning it back on just works.
  • Faster and lighter.
  • Small design touches.

1.20 · December 2022

  • Fixed the feed sometimes showing on Reddit and Facebook.

1.18 · November 2022

  • More quotes.
  • Fixed Reddit and Facebook.

1.17 · November 2022

  • Bug fixes.

1.16 · November 2022

  • Fixed Burnfeed not working on some sites.
  • A new font.
  • Each site's setting is remembered after Safari closes.

1.13 · November 2022

  • Bug fixes and better performance.

1.0 · November 2022

  • Burnfeed is here: it hides the feed on Facebook, Instagram, Twitter, YouTube, LinkedIn and Reddit, and puts a quote where the feed was.
